scope: Local verification before the release commit and tag; publication and CI are separate

backend.environment: An explicit image resource path was set, exercising fixture independence from it.
backend.reuse_after_ui_refinement: Backend, server scripts, schema and dependencies are unchanged from the full 383-test regression. Only journal/brand markup, CSS and release documentation were refined.

image_resource_fixture.regression: Four fixture failures with an inherited image cache path were reproduced and resolved by isolating the portable test class.

deployment_helpers.scope: Shared-host safeguards, retention/restore, capacity helpers, immutable images, storage paths and downloads; Docker calls mocked, temporary loopback port used

tex_package.reuse_reason: Every selected renderer source, document template, preparation script, documentation file and trusted resource has the identical hash. Release metadata and journal UI are outside the TeX contract.

browser_validation.name_display: ID only; full title in native hover tooltip and task button accessible name
browser_validation.proof: Local journal checked on 2026-11-07 after final centering and 44px-column refinement.

icon_alignment.brand_mark: Shared SVG component in sidebar, login and loading screen

resource_verification.production_measurement: Read-only counters from three samples; no production load, restart or deployment
resource_verification.export_measurement: Local 48 streamed downloads at concurrency 8; retained Python allocation delta about 31 KiB, additional concurrency peak about 11 MiB

limitations: Linux/Docker server build and PostgreSQL integration were not run locally: the existing plusfolio-check Colima profile is Broken. No VM repair was attempted.
Four PostgreSQL-only checks are skipped in the SQLite suite. The repository CI checks the Linux server, HTTPS, SMTP, TeX and real backup restoration after publication.
Local allocation measurements and short read-only production counter sampling are not a production load test.
